# Hōlus Digest — [Month Year]

Publish a future issue at `/digest/month-year/`. Do not publish this template itself.

For every selected item include:

- Category (study, article, podcast, video/talk, behaviour-change resource, practical nutrition resource, or Juliana’s pick)
- Title
- Source or creator
- Link to the original source
- A short explanation of why it was selected
- One practical takeaway

Use only real sources that Juliana has reviewed. Do not create filler selections.
